seo.title: Free Breast Milk Storage Calculator — Fridge & Freezer
seo.description: A free calculator for expressed breast milk. It works out a use-by date from NHS storage guidance, with nothing to install and no account to make.

labels.theIphoneAppsMilkStashKeepsYourFridgeAnd: The iPhone app’s Milk Stash keeps your fridge and freezer milk in one place and reminds you before it reaches its storage date.
labels.upTo8DaysAt4COrColderAtTheBackNotTheDoor: Up to 8 days at 4°C or colder, at the back, not the door
labels.upTo6MonthsAt18COrColder: Up to 6 months at −18°C or colder
labels.useItStraightAwayNeverRefreezeIt: Use it straight away. Never refreeze it.
labels.storageDatesAreGuidanceNotAGuarantee: Storage dates are guidance, not a guarantee.
labels.aFreeCalculatorForExpressedBreastMilkItW: A free calculator for expressed breast milk. It works out a use-by date from NHS storage guidance, with nothing to install and no account to make.
labels.fridgeTheFridgesIceCompartmentOrTheFreez: Fridge, the fridge’s ice compartment, or the freezer.
labels.whenYouExpressedItForTheFridgeOrWhenItWe: When you expressed it for the fridge, or when it went in the ice compartment or freezer.
labels.withTheTimeLeftAndHowLongItsBeenStoredUs: With the time left and how long it’s been stored. Use soon appears when the date is close.
labels.theCalculatorRemembersYourLastBagInThisB: The calculator remembers your last bag in this browser so it’s there when you come back. Nothing is uploaded.
labels.everyBagInTheIphoneApp: Every bag, in the iPhone app
labels.milkStashKeepsARunningListOfWhatsInYourF: Milk Stash keeps a running list of what’s in your fridge and freezer, so you don’t have to work it out bag by bag.
labels.fridgeAndFreezerTotalsAtAGlance: Fridge and freezer totals at a glance
labels.remindersBeforeMilkReachesItsStorageDate: Reminders before milk reaches its storage date
labels.useABagInABottleAndTheStashUpdates: Use a bag in a bottle and the stash updates
labels.freeToDownloadWithAnOptionalOneTimeLifet: Free to download, with an optional one-time Lifetime Unlock. I make the app on my own.
labels.whereDoTheDatesComeFrom: Where do the dates come from?
labels.fromTheNhsGuidanceOnStoringBreastMilkUpT: From the NHS guidance on storing breast milk: up to 8 days in a fridge at 4°C or colder, up to 2 weeks in the fridge’s ice compartment, and up to 6 months in a freezer at −18°C or colder.
labels.whatIfImNotSureHowColdMyFridgeIs: What if I’m not sure how cold my fridge is?
labels.the8DaysAssume4COrColderIfYouCantBeSureA: The 8 days assume 4°C or colder. If you can’t be sure, ask your midwife, health visitor or GP what’s right for you.
labels.howLongIsDefrostedMilkGoodFor: How long is defrosted milk good for?
labels.theNhsSaysToUseDefrostedMilkStraightAway: The NHS says to use defrosted milk straight away and never refreeze it. Thawing it slowly in the fridge is best, and it should never be thawed in a microwave.
labels.noTheseDatesAreOnlyForExpressedBreastMil: No. These dates are only for expressed breast milk. Formula has its own guidance on the pack and from the NHS.
labels.yesTheresNothingToSignUpForAndNothingToI: Yes. There’s nothing to sign up for and nothing to install.
labels.storageDatesAreGuidanceNotAGuaranteeAndT: Storage dates are guidance, not a guarantee, and this calculator isn’t medical advice. If your baby is in hospital, premature or unwell, follow their care team’s advice on storing milk.

faqs.question: Where do the dates come from?
faqs.answer: From the NHS guidance on storing breast milk: up to 8 days in a fridge at 4°C or colder, up to 2 weeks in the fridge’s ice compartment, and up to 6 months in a freezer at −18°C or colder.

faqs.question: What if I’m not sure how cold my fridge is?
faqs.answer: The 8 days assume 4°C or colder. If you can’t be sure, ask your midwife, health visitor or GP what’s right for you.

faqs.question: How long is defrosted milk good for?
faqs.answer: The NHS says to use defrosted milk straight away and never refreeze it. Thawing it slowly in the fridge is best, and it should never be thawed in a microwave.

faqs.question: Does this work for formula?
faqs.answer: No. These dates are only for expressed breast milk. Formula has its own guidance on the pack and from the NHS.

faqs.question: Is it free?
faqs.answer: Yes. There’s nothing to sign up for and nothing to install.
